messages:
jessica_cs: customer ACME just reported that promo code ACME50 won't apply (UI and API). API returns 'code_not_applicable' and UI shows "expired" even though dashboard shows it active. Can eng look? need quick triage, they're blocked for a launch :grimacing:

liam_pse: can you paste customer id + sample API request/responses? i can repro if i have the payload

jessica_cs: cust_id=acme-inc-402, sample curl below — response is 200 but body has {\"status\":\"error\",\"code\":\"promo_not_applicable\",\"reason\":\"expired\"}

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"customer_id":"acme-inc-402","code":"ACME50"}'

liam_pse: reproducing locally now. also, did they import this promo via CSV recently? saw a handful of import-related bugs earlier.

jessica_cs: yes, marketing did a bulk import last week for the ACME50 campaign. they edited redemption limits in the sheet.

promo-bot: promo-service detected config inconsistency for code=ACME50: dashboard.end_date=2025-05-31T23:59:59Z, db.end_date=2025-05-30T23:59:59Z; redemption_limit=0, redeemed_count=24

matt_eng: looking at DB now. agree there's a mismatch. the import pipeline set redemption_limit=0 for that row (CSV had blank) and our import code interpreted blank->0. our eligibility check currently treats limit<=redeemed_count as exhausted, so 0 means blocked. that's the bug.

matt_eng: promo object (from postgres):
```
{\n  id: 98321,\n  code: 'ACME50',\n  start_date: '2025-05-01T00:00:00Z',\n  end_date: '2025-05-30T23:59:59Z',\n  redemption_limit: 0,\n  redeemed_count: 24,\n  per_user_limit: 1\n}
```

sara_billing: if we do a mass backfill or one-time grant we need to record ledger entries. how many affected users would we credit?

jessica_cs: marketing said ~24 users already redeemed; additional ~120 tried and failed since launch. customer is asking for credits for the failed claims.

matt_eng: plan: 1) fix import pipeline to treat empty as NULL (unlimited) or explicit numeric; 2) run migration to convert redemption_limit=0 -> NULL for affected promos; 3) re-run eligibility checks for pending claim failures and run a one-time credit job for the ~120 failed attempts. i'll avoid changing global semantics (0 shouldn't mean exhausted).

matt_eng: proposed SQL (staging/test first):
```
UPDATE promos SET redemption_limit = NULL
WHERE code = 'ACME50' AND redemption_limit = 0 AND start_date <= now();
```

matt_eng: and a backfill to re-process claim logs where result=\"promo_not_applicable\" and code=ACME50 and attempted_at between '2025-05-01' and now() — then enqueue credit jobs.

hana_support: i'll prepare the list of affected accounts and copy the claim logs so billing can approve the ledger entries. tagging @sara_billing for approvals.

sara_billing: thanks — need a spreadsheet with account id, attempted_at, amount, and reason. once we have that i'll approve refunds/credits.

jessica_cs: ACME is already on the line, asking for ETA. can we prioritize?

matt_eng: i'll open PR for import fix + migration now, run through staging acceptance tests. estimate 3h to deploy + backfill and then we'll queue the credit job. will update this thread with PR/link.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/promo-import/merge_requests/678 (fix: treat blank redemption_limit as NULL + migration) — deploy scheduled to staging at 15:30 UTC.

matt_eng: after staging verification i'll schedule a short maintenance window for prod deploy and run the backfill with throttle. will post final ETA when staging passes.

hana_support: i'll draft the customer message: apologize, explain root cause (CSV import interpreted blank as 0 -> blocked), and say we're running a fix + credits. will hold until we have confirmation from eng and billing. :pray:
